local_party: State of Illinois; City of Chicago; Cook County
what_en: The Justice Department sued Illinois, Chicago and Cook County over laws that limit local help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. Illinois, N.D. Ill.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Illinois, Chicago y el condado de Cook por leyes que limitan la ayuda local al control migratorio federal (United States v. Illinois, N.D. Ill.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case with prejudice; the United States appealed to the Seventh Circuit.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso de forma definitiva; Estados Unidos apeló ante el Séptimo Circuito.

local_party: San Francisco; Santa Clara County; other local governments
what_en: San Francisco, Santa Clara County and other local governments sued over an executive order and a Justice Department memo directing federal funding cuts to places that limit help with immigration enforcement (City and County of San Francisco v. Trump, N.D. Cal.).
what_es: San Francisco, el condado de Santa Clara y otros gobiernos locales demandaron por una orden ejecutiva y un memorando del Departamento de Justicia que ordenan recortar fondos federales a lugares que limitan la ayuda al control migratorio (City and County of San Francisco v. Trump, N.D. Cal.).
status_en: A preliminary injunction blocking the cuts was granted and later extended; the district case is paused while the government's appeal is before the Ninth Circuit.
status_es: Se concedió una orden judicial preliminar que bloquea los recortes, luego ampliada; el caso está en pausa mientras la apelación del gobierno sigue ante el Noveno Circuito.

what_en: The Justice Department sued Rochester over its policy limiting city help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. City of Rochester, W.D.N.Y.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Rochester por su política que limita la ayuda de la ciudad al control migratorio federal (United States v. City of Rochester, W.D.N.Y.).
status_en: The court dismissed the amended complaint with prejudice and closed the case.
status_es: La corte desestimó de forma definitiva la demanda enmendada y cerró el caso.

local_party: State of Colorado; City and County of Denver
what_en: The Justice Department sued Colorado and Denver over four state laws and two city ordinances that limit help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. Colorado, D. Colo.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Colorado y Denver por cuatro leyes estatales y dos ordenanzas de la ciudad que limitan la ayuda al control migratorio federal (United States v. Colorado, D. Colo.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case on March 31, 2026; the United States appealed to the Tenth Circuit.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso el 31 de marzo de 2026; Estados Unidos apeló ante el Décimo Circuito.

what_en: Twenty states sued DHS and FEMA over conditions on homeland security grants that require cooperation with immigration enforcement (Illinois v. FEMA, D.R.I.).
what_es: Veinte estados demandaron al DHS y a FEMA por condiciones en subvenciones de seguridad nacional que exigen cooperar con el control migratorio (Illinois v. FEMA, D.R.I.).
status_en: The court ruled for the states and found the conditions unlawful.
status_es: La corte falló a favor de los estados y declaró ilegales las condiciones.

place: Newark, Jersey City, Paterson and Hoboken
what_en: The Justice Department sued four New Jersey cities over policies that limit city help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. City of Newark, D.N.J.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a cuatro ciudades de Nueva Jersey por políticas que limitan la ayuda municipal al control migratorio federal (United States v. City of Newark, D.N.J.).
status_en: The court dismissed the complaint for lack of standing and allowed 45 days to file a new one.
status_es: La corte desestimó la demanda por falta de legitimación y dio 45 días para presentar una nueva.

what_en: California sued over the federal takeover of 2,000 California National Guard members, ordered to protect DHS functions including ICE operations in Los Angeles (Newsom v. Trump, N.D. Cal.).
what_es: California demandó por el control federal de 2,000 miembros de la Guardia Nacional de California, ordenado para proteger funciones del DHS, incluidas operaciones de ICE en Los Ángeles (Newsom v. Trump, N.D. Cal.).
status_en: The district court barred continued federal control of the Guard members; the Ninth Circuit lifted its partial pause of that order.
status_es: La corte de distrito prohibió que continuara el control federal de la Guardia; el Noveno Circuito levantó su suspensión parcial de esa orden.

what_en: The Justice Department sued New York over its Protect Our Courts Act, which limits civil immigration arrests at and near courthouses (United States v. New York, N.D.N.Y.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Nueva York por su Ley Protect Our Courts, que limita los arrestos migratorios civiles en los tribunales y sus alrededores (United States v. New York, N.D.N.Y.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case, finding the law is not overridden by federal immigration law.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso al concluir que la ley no queda anulada por la ley migratoria federal.

what_en: The Justice Department sued Los Angeles over its ordinance barring the use of city resources for federal immigration enforcement (United States v. City of Los Angeles, C.D. Cal.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Los Ángeles por su ordenanza que prohíbe usar recursos de la ciudad para el control migratorio federal (United States v. City of Los Angeles, C.D. Cal.).
status_en: The court granted the city's motion to dismiss.
status_es: La corte aceptó la moción de la ciudad para desestimar el caso.

federal_party: Health and Human Services; Department of Homeland Security
what_en: Twenty states sued HHS and DHS over the transfer of state Medicaid enrollees' data to DHS for immigration enforcement (California v. HHS, N.D. Cal.).
what_es: Veinte estados demandaron al HHS y al DHS por la entrega de datos de inscritos en Medicaid al DHS para el control migratorio (California v. HHS, N.D. Cal.).
status_en: Preliminary injunctions partly blocking the data sharing were granted; the states asked the court on March 26, 2026 to enforce them.
status_es: Se concedieron órdenes preliminares que bloquean en parte el intercambio de datos; el 26 de marzo de 2026 los estados pidieron a la corte que las haga cumplir.

what_en: The Justice Department sued New York City over its laws that limit city help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. City of New York, E.D.N.Y.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a la ciudad de Nueva York por sus leyes que limitan la ayuda municipal al control migratorio federal (United States v. City of New York, E.D.N.Y.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case and closed it.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso y lo cerró.

officials: Michelle Wu (Mayor of Boston / alcaldesa de Boston)
what_en: The Justice Department sued Boston over its Trust Act and related policies that limit city help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. City of Boston, D. Mass.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Boston por su Ley Trust y políticas relacionadas que limitan la ayuda municipal al control migratorio federal (United States v. City of Boston, D. Mass.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case for lack of standing on May 28, 2026; the United States appealed to the First Circuit.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso por falta de legitimación el 28 de mayo de 2026; Estados Unidos apeló ante el Primer Circuito.

place: Minnesota, Minneapolis, Saint Paul and Hennepin County
local_party: State of Minnesota; Minneapolis; Saint Paul; Hennepin County
what_en: The Justice Department sued Minnesota, Minneapolis, Saint Paul and Hennepin County over their policies on immigration detainers and data sharing (United States v. Minnesota, D. Minn.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Minnesota, Minneapolis, Saint Paul y el condado de Hennepin por sus políticas sobre órdenes de retención migratoria e intercambio de datos (United States v. Minnesota, D. Minn.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso.

federal_party: President; Defense Department; Department of Homeland Security
local_party: State of Illinois; City of Chicago
what_en: Illinois and Chicago sued over the federal takeover and deployment of National Guard troops that the government said were needed to protect ICE staff and facilities, including the Broadview processing site (Illinois v. Trump, N.D. Ill.).
what_es: Illinois y Chicago demandaron por el control federal y el despliegue de tropas de la Guardia Nacional que, según el gobierno, eran necesarias para proteger al personal y las instalaciones de ICE, incluido el centro de procesamiento de Broadview (Illinois v. Trump, N.D. Ill.).
status_en: The Supreme Court refused the government's request to allow the deployment; the district court later dismissed the case as moot.
status_es: La Corte Suprema rechazó la solicitud del gobierno de permitir el despliegue; la corte de distrito luego desestimó el caso por haber quedado sin objeto.

what_en: The Justice Department sued California over two 2025 laws that limit face coverings for officers and require them to show identification (United States v. California, C.D. Cal.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a California por dos leyes de 2025 que limitan que los agentes se cubran el rostro y les exigen mostrar identificación (United States v. California, C.D. Cal.).
status_en: The Ninth Circuit reversed the district court's refusal to block the identification requirement and told it to issue a preliminary injunction against that requirement.
status_es: El Noveno Circuito revocó la decisión de la corte de distrito de no bloquear el requisito de identificación y le ordenó emitir una orden preliminar contra ese requisito.

officials: JB Pritzker (Governor of Illinois / gobernador de Illinois); Kwame Raoul (Attorney General of Illinois / fiscal general de Illinois)
what_en: The Justice Department sued Illinois over two 2025 state laws, the Illinois Bivens Act and the Courts Access, Safety, and Participation Act (United States v. Illinois, S.D. Ill.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Illinois por dos leyes estatales de 2025, la Illinois Bivens Act y la Courts Access, Safety, and Participation Act (United States v. Illinois, S.D. Ill.).
status_en: The court denied Illinois's motion to dismiss and ordered the state to answer the complaint.
status_es: La corte rechazó la moción de Illinois para desestimar el caso y ordenó al estado responder a la demanda.

local_party: State of Minnesota; Minneapolis; Saint Paul
what_en: Minnesota, Minneapolis and Saint Paul sued DHS to stop Operation Metro Surge, a deployment of DHS agents, including ICE, to the Twin Cities (D. Minn.).
what_es: Minnesota, Minneapolis y Saint Paul demandaron al DHS para detener la Operación Metro Surge, un despliegue de agentes del DHS, incluido ICE, en las Ciudades Gemelas (D. Minn.).
status_en: The court heard the federal government's motion to dismiss the case as moot on September 9, 2026; no ruling found.
status_es: La corte escuchó el 9 de septiembre de 2026 la moción del gobierno federal para desestimar el caso por haber quedado sin objeto; no se encontró decisión.

what_en: The Justice Department sued New Jersey over Executive Order No. 12, which bars civil immigration arrests in nonpublic areas of state property (United States v. New Jersey, D.N.J.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Nueva Jersey por la Orden Ejecutiva n.º 12, que prohíbe arrestos migratorios civiles en áreas no públicas de propiedades del estado (United States v. New Jersey, D.N.J.).
status_en: The court dismissed the case; the executive order remains in effect.
status_es: La corte desestimó el caso; la orden ejecutiva sigue vigente.

what_en: Maryland sued DHS and ICE over ICE's purchase of a Williamsport warehouse and its plan to turn it into a detention facility (Maryland v. Noem, D. Md.).
what_es: Maryland demandó al DHS y a ICE por la compra de un almacén en Williamsport y el plan de ICE de convertirlo en un centro de detención (Maryland v. Noem, D. Md.).
status_en: The court issued a preliminary injunction barring building out or operating the facility while the case continues.
status_es: La corte emitió una orden preliminar que prohíbe acondicionar u operar el centro mientras sigue el caso.

local_party: State of Michigan; City of Romulus
what_en: Michigan and Romulus sued DHS and ICE over ICE's plan to turn a Romulus warehouse into a detention center (E.D. Mich.).
what_es: Michigan y Romulus demandaron al DHS y a ICE por el plan de ICE de convertir un almacén de Romulus en un centro de detención (E.D. Mich.).
status_en: ICE said it would sell the warehouse instead of using it for detention; the case stays open until a written agreement is made.
status_es: ICE dijo que venderá el almacén en lugar de usarlo para detención; el caso sigue abierto hasta que haya un acuerdo por escrito.

local_party: State of Connecticut; City of New Haven
what_en: The Justice Department sued Connecticut and New Haven over the state's Trust Act and city policies that limit help with federal immigration enforcement (United States v. Connecticut, D. Conn.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Connecticut y New Haven por la Ley Trust del estado y políticas de la ciudad que limitan la ayuda al control migratorio federal (United States v. Connecticut, D. Conn.).

what_en: Arizona sued DHS and ICE over a proposed ICE detention facility in a Surprise warehouse (Arizona v. Mullin, D. Ariz.).
what_es: Arizona demandó al DHS y a ICE por un centro de detención de ICE propuesto en un almacén de Surprise (Arizona v. Mullin, D. Ariz.).
status_en: The case is paused by agreement; the federal side agreed not to hold people or begin conversion work there until its environmental review is complete.
status_es: El caso está en pausa por acuerdo; la parte federal se comprometió a no detener personas ni empezar obras allí hasta terminar su revisión ambiental.

what_en: The Justice Department sued Oregon over a state policy that denies confidential license plates to federal agencies, including ICE; it filed similar suits against three other states the same day.
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Oregón por una política estatal que niega placas de matrícula confidenciales a agencias federales, incluida ICE; ese mismo día presentó demandas similares contra otros tres estados.

what_en: The Justice Department sued Washington over a state policy that denies confidential license plates to federal agencies, including ICE; it filed similar suits against three other states the same day.
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Washington por una política estatal que niega placas de matrícula confidenciales a agencias federales, incluida ICE; ese mismo día presentó demandas similares contra otros tres estados.

what_en: The Justice Department sued Massachusetts over a state policy that denies confidential license plates to federal agencies, including ICE; it filed similar suits against three other states the same day.
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Massachusetts por una política estatal que niega placas de matrícula confidenciales a agencias federales, incluida ICE; ese mismo día presentó demandas similares contra otros tres estados.

what_en: The Justice Department sued Maine over a state policy that denies confidential license plates to federal agencies, including ICE; it filed similar suits against three other states the same day.
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Maine por una política estatal que niega placas de matrícula confidenciales a agencias federales, incluida ICE; ese mismo día presentó demandas similares contra otros tres estados.

place: Salt Lake City and Salt Lake County
local_party: Salt Lake City; Salt Lake County
what_en: Salt Lake City and Salt Lake County sued DHS over its purchase of a warehouse to turn into an immigration detention facility (Salt Lake City Corporation v. Mullin, D. Utah).
what_es: Salt Lake City y el condado de Salt Lake demandaron al DHS por la compra de un almacén para convertirlo en un centro de detención migratoria (Salt Lake City Corporation v. Mullin, D. Utah).

what_en: The Justice Department sued Maryland over its Community Trust Act and its handling of immigration detainers (D. Md.).
what_es: El Departamento de Justicia demandó a Maryland por su Ley Community Trust y su manejo de las órdenes de retención migratoria (D. Md.).

what_en: California sued DHS and ICE over ICE's courthouse enforcement directive and civil immigration arrests at California courthouses (C.D. Cal.).
what_es: California demandó al DHS y a ICE por la directiva de ICE sobre operaciones en tribunales y los arrestos migratorios civiles en tribunales de California (C.D. Cal.).
